verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.250
25. Bad Conduct
Faith in Individuals
“Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of placing faith in an individual.
What five?

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṁ āpattiṁ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ukkhipati.
verses.english: The individual to whom an individual is devoted falls into an offense such that the Saṅgha suspends them.
It occurs to them:

verses.pali: ‘yo kho myāyaṁ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṅghena ukkhitto’ti.
verses.english: ‘This individual dear and beloved to me has been suspended by the Saṅgha.’
They lose much of their faith in mendicants.

verses.pali: Bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati.
verses.english: So they don’t frequent other mendicants,

verses.pali: Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṁ na suṇāti.
verses.english: they don’t hear the true teaching,
and they fall away from the true teaching.
This is the first drawback in placing faith in an individual.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, yasmiṁ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so tathārūpaṁ āpattiṁ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṅgho ante nisīdāpeti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the individual to whom an individual is devoted falls into an offense such that the Saṅgha makes them sit at the end of the line. …

verses.pali: ‘yo kho myāyaṁ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṅghena ante nisīdāpito’ti.
Bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati.
Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṁ na suṇāti.

verses.english: This is the second drawback in placing faith in an individual.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, yasmiṁ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti, so disāpakkanto hoti …pe… so vibbhanto hoti …pe… so kālaṅkato hoti.
verses.english: Furthermore, the individual to whom an individual is devoted leaves for another region … disrobes … passes away.
It occurs to them:

verses.pali: ‘yo kho myāyaṁ puggalo piyo manāpo so kālaṅkato’ti.
verses.english: ‘This individual dear and beloved to me has passed away.’
So they don’t frequent other mendicants,

verses.pali: Aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṁ na suṇāti.
verses.english: they don’t hear the true teaching,
and they fall away from the true teaching.
This is the fifth drawback in placing faith in an individual.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā puggalappasāde”ti.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of placing faith in an individual.”
